displayPattern: 7-segment display on an American Standard S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace: E3.2
causes: 1st stage pressure switch did not close
diySteps: The heating sequence says the inducer starts and pressure switch 1 should then close. If a thermal limit is open, the guide says 24 VAC will not be present at either pressure switch
The install steps say pressure-switch tubing must rise so condensed flue gas does not enter the switch
Technician: check the 1st stage pressure switch, its tubing and the inducer
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if E3.2 remains. First-stage heat will not prove until that switch closes.
